description: Starts an operator checkout for a town and returns a hosted payment URL. CHARGES NOTHING: a person must open the URL and enter card details before anything is bought, and the email they enter there becomes the operator account. The town is held for a short reservation window and released if the checkout is not completed. Call get_town_quote first to confirm availability and price.
name: start_town_checkout
title: Get a payment link to lease a town
